$comment: Incutec's public financial goals. Edited in the studio's Goals tab. mode 'auto' goals are updated by scripts/update-goals.mjs (weekly community-sync workflow) from Shopify order totals: gross since `since` x allocation_pct / target_eur, floored to 5% steps so the public meter stays approximate. target_eur and allocation_pct are inputs, never displayed. Read by app/lib/goals.ts.

goals.title: A pick and place machine
goals.body: The first step toward assembling boards in Belgium instead of only inspecting them here. A desktop pick and place plus reflow setup lets us run small batches and revisions in-house, and every product page stops saying 'assembled in China' one board at a time.

goals.title: A full EU assembly line
goals.body: Everything the pick and place does not cover: solder paste printing, inspection, and enough throughput to run production batches, not just prototypes. This is the 'EU assembly is an ambition' line on the production page becoming a fact.
